# File map

Every source file, one line each. Read this to choose what to open, instead
of searching. The line is the file's own header docblock where it has one,
and `file_map.overrides.json` where it does not.

## lib — domain rules, the HTTP client, pure helpers. No React.

- `src/lib/api.ts` — The only module in the app that knows a server exists.
- `src/lib/api_types.ts` — The HTTP contract between the app and the localization service.
- `src/lib/bundle_diff.ts` — Reading an uploaded language file, and working out what importing it would change.
- `src/lib/clipboard.ts` — Copying text to the clipboard, with the fallback the dev server needs.
- `src/lib/coverage.ts` — Derivations over `GET /api/coverage`.
- `src/lib/file_name.ts` — Shared by the export dialog and the server route, so the names the fields resolve to are the names the archive gets.
- `src/lib/format_date.ts` — Dates, formatted the same way everywhere they are shown.
- `src/lib/locale_data.ts` — The localization domain model — types and the pure rules over them.
- `src/lib/motion.ts` — The app’s one motion vocabulary: the durations, eases and variants every animated component uses.
- `src/lib/template_data.ts` — Message templates — the domain model behind the Others targets.
- `src/lib/template_preview.ts` — Turning a template field into something that can be rendered as the reader will see it.
- `src/lib/utils.ts` — `cn()` — the Tailwind class merger every component imports.
- `src/lib/validation.ts` — Per-row checks on a translation.
- `src/lib/workspace_link.ts` — Builds a workspace URL with its filters in the query string, so a link from the dashboard opens the list already scoped — `/web/school?lang=vi&group=nav`.

## mock — the stand-in backend. Runtime-agnostic.

- `src/mock/browser_backend.ts` — The mock backend, running in the tab.
- `src/mock/file_store.ts` — The one thing the mock backend needs from whatever it is running on: a flat store of small text documents, addressed by path.
- `src/mock/router.ts` — The mock localization backend's routes, written against `Request` and `Response` rather than against any one server.
- `src/mock/store.ts` — The mock backend's storage layer: a handful of JSON documents, addressed by path through `FileStore`.
- `src/mock/zip.ts` — A minimal ZIP writer — enough to hand the browser an archive of locale files.

## server — the mock's Node half, mounted on the Vite dev server.

- `server/mock_api.ts` — Mounts the mock localization backend on the Vite dev server at `/api`.
- `server/node_file_store.ts` — The dev server's half of the mock backend: `FileStore` over real files.

## hooks — one hook per request a screen makes.

- `src/hooks/use-mobile.ts` — Viewport width as a boolean, for the sidebar's drawer/rail switch. shadcn-generated name, hence the dash.
- `src/hooks/use_coverage.ts` — Dashboard totals from `GET /api/coverage`.
- `src/hooks/use_target_bundles.ts` — One app's keys in *several* languages at once — what the import wizard needs and `use_translation_rows.ts` deliberately does not do.
- `src/hooks/use_templates.ts` — One channel's templates in one language, from `GET /api/templates`.
- `src/hooks/use_translation_rows.ts` — One app's keys in one language, from `GET /api/entries`.

## config — static app configuration, no I/O.

- `src/config/current_user.ts` — Who the app is acting as.
- `src/config/nav_items.ts` — The sidebar tree, and the source of every route: `/{section.id}/{leaf.id}`.
- `src/config/target_profiles.ts` — One profile per menu target, keyed by its URL path (`web/school`).

## pages — one per route.

- `src/pages/dashboard_page.tsx` — Route `/` — coverage stat tiles, the gaps card and the jump-in shortcuts.
- `src/pages/import_page.tsx` — Route: `/import` — the import wizard, `?target=web/school` optional.
- `src/pages/target_page.tsx` — Route: `/:sectionId/:leafId` — one component per target, chosen by the target's content kind rather than by its section.
- `src/pages/templates_page.tsx` — Route: `/others/:channel` — the template list for one channel.
- `src/pages/translations_page.tsx` — Route: `/:sectionId/:leafId` — the target comes from the path, the filters a link needs to carry come from the query string (`?lang=vi&group=nav&q=`), so a workspace view can be…

## components/layout — the app shell.

- `src/components/layout/app_header.tsx` — Top bar: sidebar trigger, breadcrumb, language picker, theme toggle.
- `src/components/layout/app_layout.tsx` — Shell shared by every route: sidebar, header, scrollable content slot.
- `src/components/layout/app_sidebar.tsx` — The nav tree from `config/nav_items.ts`, with its outstanding-count badges.

## components/dashboard — home screen cards.

- `src/components/dashboard/gaps_card.tsx` — The groups holding the most keys that are missing or flagged, per language.
- `src/components/dashboard/language_coverage_card.tsx` — A key only counts as translated once it has a value of its own, so a bundle exported with English as its fallback reads near zero here — which is the honest number.
- `src/components/dashboard/shortcut_card.tsx` — One nav leaf as a jump-in tile.
- `src/components/dashboard/stat_tile.tsx` — One headline number with a label and hint; skeletons while it loads.

## components/translations — the UI-key workspace.

- `src/components/translations/add_key_dialog.tsx` — Adding a key belongs to an app, not to the product.
- `src/components/translations/bundle_diff_view.tsx` — What the import would do, laid out the way a pull request lays out its files.
- `src/components/translations/delete_keys_dialog.tsx` — The one confirmation for every delete on the workspace — one row's trash button and a selection of four thousand reach the same dialog, because they ask the same question and a …
- `src/components/translations/export_dialog.tsx` — Exports one app as a zip of locale files.
- `src/components/translations/group_filter.tsx` — Searchable group combobox; `ALL_GROUPS` is its unset sentinel.
- `src/components/translations/target_profile_card.tsx` — The empty state for an app with no keys yet — nine of the ten, until someone adds one or imports a bundle.
- `src/components/translations/translation_row.tsx` — The single row editor.

## components/templates — the message-template screen.

- `src/components/templates/rich_text_editor.tsx` — The editor for a mail body: formatting as formatting, not as angle brackets.
- `src/components/templates/template_dialog.tsx` — Translating one template: the fields on the left, the message as its reader gets it on the right.
- `src/components/templates/template_field_editor.tsx` — One field of a template: the English above, the translation below, the checks and the budget under that.
- `src/components/templates/template_preview.tsx` — The message as its reader gets it.
- `src/components/templates/template_table.tsx` — The template list — one row per message, opened for translation by clicking it.

## components/motion — animation primitives.

- `src/components/motion/animated_number.tsx` — Counts up to `value` instead of snapping to it.
- `src/components/motion/animated_progress.tsx` — The shadcn `Progress`, grown from zero on mount rather than painted full.
- `src/components/motion/fade_in.tsx` — One block of content, faded and lifted into place on mount.
- `src/components/motion/lift.tsx` — The hover affordance for anything clickable and card-shaped: it rises a little under the pointer and presses back down on click.
- `src/components/motion/motion_provider.tsx` — Wraps the app once so every `motion` element inherits the same default transition, and so `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` disables transforms app-wide without a single componen…
- `src/components/motion/stagger.tsx` — Deals its children in one after another.

## src — entry points and anything uncategorised.

- `src/App.tsx` — The route table: providers, the shell route, and `/:sectionId/:leafId` under it.
- `src/components/theme_toggle.tsx` — Light/dark switch over next-themes.
- `src/index.css` — Tailwind v4 entry and every shadcn design token, light and dark. The only stylesheet.
- `src/main.tsx` — Mounts `App` into `#root`. Nothing else lives here.
